documents.title: Ambassador Briggs Telegram 1235 on May 1954 election returns and Assembly blocs
documents.author: Ellis O. Briggs
documents.institution: U.S. Embassy Seoul / U.S. Department of State
documents.source_kind: contemporaneous original telegram in FRUS transcription
documents.notes: English editorial note cites May23 telegram1231: Liberal115, DNP15, independent67, minor6 =203; Korean translation gives minor7 =204. Actual Telegram 1231 not opened. Official endorsed Liberal candidates described as 3 short of absolute majority, distinct from 115 aggregate classification; no personal voting inference.

documents.title: Ambassador Briggs Despatch No.5 on conduct of 1954 National Assembly elections
documents.author: Ellis O. Briggs (signed for Ambassador by John A. Calhoun)
documents.institution: U.S. Embassy Seoul / U.S. Department of State
documents.source_kind: contemporaneous diplomatic report, observations plus interpretation
documents.notes: Police interference and ballot bundle in Pusan C reported; five American officer memoranda attached to original but NOT printed in FRUS, British Legation two memoranda transmitted as despatch22 June4 also NOT printed. No direct presidential order evidenced.

documents.title: 국사편찬위원회 헌정사 DB 1954년 제2차 개헌 해제(후대 종합)
documents.source_kind: later institutional scholarly essay, not original source
documents.notes: Narrates Liberal 114 elected, 127 at June9 assembly opening, 136 at June16 negotiating group registration; original group registration sheets not opened. Gives 1954 speaker ballot Yi Ki-pung124, Shin Ik-hui52, Chang Taek-sang15, Yun Chi-yeong7; original tally not yet opened.
